english.title: Possess thing designed / adapted for use in connection with an animal fight w/i of it being used
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) possessed a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..), designed or adapted for use in connection with an animal fight with the intention of its being so used
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 8(1)(g) and 32(1) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 8(7) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006 provides that references to "animal fight" means an occasion on which a protected animal is placed with an animal, or with a human, for the purpose of fighting, wrestling or baiting.
(ii) See section 33 for privation orders.
(iii) See section 34 for disqualification from owning keeping animals.
(iv) See section 35 for power to seize animals in connection with disqualification.
(v) See section 37 for destruction in the interests of the animal.
(vi) See section 38 for destruction of an animal involved in fighting offences.
(vii) See section 40 for the forfeiture of equipment used.
(viii) The maximum penalty for this offence was increased by the Animal Welfare (Sentencing) Act 2021 from the 29th April 2021, with the offence now becoming either way rather than summary. For the offence applying after 29th April 2021, see H22930 / AW06059.

other.timelimitforprosecutions: Complex see section 31 of the Act
other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding £20,000.

NOTE:
Section 32(5) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006 provides that In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 6 months.
